summary: Implements REST API endpoints and Airflow orchestration for Hive-to-Delta Lake migration on Databricks with ACID transactions, Z-order optimization, time travel, and Unity Catalog registration. Provides zero-downtime dashboard compatibility and governance integration.

code_files.description: Handles API endpoints for Delta migration start and status retrieval
Controller to trigger Z-ordering and compaction for optimization
Controller to register Delta tables into Unity Catalog
Implements core Delta Lake operations via Databricks API and CLI commands
Handles Unity Catalog registration using Databricks REST API
Defines all REST routes for migration and optimization endpoints
Main Express server for API endpoints

setup_instructions: Create .env file with required Databricks credentials

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL or Databricks metadata connection string

environment_variables.name: DATABRICKS_API_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL for Databricks workspace REST API

environment_variables.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Personal access token for Databricks REST API operations

dependencies.name: axios
dependencies.purpose: HTTP client for Databricks API interactions

dependencies.name: uuid
dependencies.purpose: Generate unique job IDs for migration tasks
